subject: gk
question:
Which of the following is the correct match of the column-A with column-B? 

 
 

 
 
**Column-A (Nutrients) **

 
 
 
**Column-B (Source)**

 
 
 

 
 
i.

 
 
 
Protein rich food 

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
Wheat

 
 
 

 
 
ii.

 
 
 
Fat rich food 

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
Lemon

 
 
 

 
 
iii.

 
 
 
Carbohydrate rich food 

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
Egg white 

 
 
 

 
 
iv.

 
 
 
Vitamin C rich food 

 
 
 
d.

 
 
 
Butter and cheese

options.text: i - c, ii - a, iii - b, iv - d
i - c, ii - d, iii - b, iv - a
i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b
i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a

solution:
The correct answer is__** i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Protein-rich **food sources are eggs, lean meats, dairy products, and beans.
 
• **Fat-rich food **sources are butter, cheese, nuts, and fatty fish.
 
• **Carbohydrate-rich food** sources are bread, pasta, rice, potatoes, and fruits.
 
• **Vitamin C rich food sources** are citrus fruits, strawberries, kiwi, broccoli, and peppers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Wheat **is a **carbohydrate-rich **food source, not a protein-rich one.
 
• **Lemon** is not a significant source of fat, it is mostly known for its **high vitamin C content**.
 
• **Egg white** is a good source of** protein**, not a carbohydrate-rich food source.
 
• **Butter and cheese** are high in **fat,** not a source of vitamin C.
